title: asterisk is icon not label text
name: Asterisk is an icon, not label text
rule: Required marker uses a spaced icon. If you use an asterisk, include hint text that explains what it means. Never use an asterisk to mark optional.
pass_when: Required is a spaced icon (not asterisk characters inside the label string); hint text explains the marker; optional is not marked with an asterisk.
fail_when: Asterisk is typed as label text; no explanation of the marker; or asterisk marks optional.
overview: Required uses a spaced icon with hint text; never asterisk optional.
apply_when: Marking required fields on Spectrum text fields and forms.
not_when: Asterisk typed into label text, unexplained markers, or asterisk-marked optional.
agent_hint: Mark required with a spaced icon plus hint text; never use asterisk for optional.
description: Required marker uses a spaced icon. If you use an asterisk, include hint text that explains what it means. Never use an asterisk to mark optional. Pass when required is a spaced icon (not asterisk characters inside the label string), hint text explains the marker, and optional is not marked with an asterisk. Fail when asterisk is typed as label text, there is no explanation of the marker, or asterisk marks optional.
do_not_claim: A winner vs NN/g mark-optional (`forms.fields.distinguish_optional_required`) or Fluent all-required-one-instruction. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.fields.distinguish_optional_required`. Overlap with extra 73: `fluent.required-asterisk-or-one-instruction`.
